text: Five pairs to keep apart. Give up, stop trying; not give in, yield to pressure. At the eleventh hour, at the last moment; not in the nick of time, just in time and successfully. A close shave, a narrow escape; not a clean sweep, a complete win. Turn a blind eye, ignore deliberately; not see eye to eye, agree. Call it a day, stop working for now; not call the shots, be in control.
